text.tspan: X ∈ { α0, α1, α2, γ, βintra, βinter, βclimate }

svg.text: εt,intra[v] × INTRA[i, t] + εt,inter[v] × INTER[i, t]
Linear predictor for individual i, population k, year t, vital rate v
η[i, t, v] = ηind[i, t, v] + ηcrowd[i, t, v] + ηclim[i, t, v] + ηyear[i, t, v]
All the Green coefficients [k, v] are set by the population level
